test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

_ _ MSDRTM _ _ R _ _ SD _ TM _ D
solution:
Given : _ _ MSDRTM _ _ R _ _ SD _ TM _ D 

By checking options :

 
• RSTDTMRS → __R__ **__S__** MSDRTM **__T__** __D__ R __T__ __M__ SD __R__ TM __S__ D → (It doesn't Follows the pattern) 
 
• RTSDMTRS → __R__ __T__ MSDRTM __S__ __D__ R **__M__** **__T__** SD __R__ TM __S__ D → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• RTSDMTSR → __R__ __T__ MSDRTM __S__ __D__ R **__M__** **__T__** SD **__S__** TM **__R__** D → (It doesn't Follows the pattern)
 
• RTSDTMRS → __**R**__ __**T**__ MSDRTM __**S**__ __**D**__ R __**T**__ __**M**__ SD __**R**__ TM __**S**__ D → (It follows the pattern of : RTMSD - RTMSD - RTMSD - RTMSD)

⇒Option - (4) gives the pattern of "__R__ __T__ MSD - RTM __S__ __D__ - R __T__ __M__ SD - __R__ TM __S__ D"

Hence, "**RTSDTMRS**" is the correct answer.
